source.commit_tree_verification: GitHub Git Commits API: synthesized f822b3d has parents 97c263c and afaf969c; f822b3d and afaf969c have identical tree 5b65169b. This is initial PR evidence, not the subsequently integrated main/current head.

method.absolute_summary: Median/min/max of four JVM nearest-rank quantiles; all four values retained. No pooling of frames across JVMs.
method.paired_change: 100*(current/baseline-1) for each matched JVM pair; reported median/min/max across four pairs. This differs from ratio of absolute medians.
method.p99_limit: Nearest-rank p99 of 90 samples is the single maximum; phase p99 of 45 samples is also the single maximum.
method.timing_scope: Synthetic UI submission; completed_ms includes glFinish. Backdrop/readback/files excluded. Not client FPS, GPU timestamps or startup time.
method.allocation_scope: Render-thread Java heap only; native/direct/GPU memory excluded.
method.timing_gate: None: timings are evidence, not a noisy pass/fail speed threshold
method.phase_method: Measured sample index modulo 2: Gaussian radii 7/11 and bloom iterations 2/3. Phase p50 is nearest-rank within each JVM, then median/min/max across JVMs. Mixed overall distributions are also retained.
method.coverage: Pbuffer/FBO, actual shaders/fonts, two viewport/GUI scales; excludes native Display, worlds, shaderpacks and game FPS

scope_layout_probe.method: Isolated local Temurin 8 Java Instrumentation.getObjectSize after Unsafe.allocateInstance; constructors and GL not executed. Shallow object size only, not an allocation stack or render benchmark.
scope_layout_probe.inference: Pack-off call paths allocate two RenderState scopes for Gaussian/glass and four for clipped bloom, consistent with observed +32/+64 bytes per render. UiDrawState does not grow. This is strong size/count agreement, not allocation-stack attribution; it does not establish the cause of timing tails.

native_query_fixture_followup.failure: gpu_queries alone failed at the first GL11.glFlush with X11 BadMatch (request 130, minor 3), using Pbuffer default drawable; successful neighboring new probes used own FBOs.
native_query_fixture_followup.change: GpuPassTimingsNativeCheck now uses established PbufferTestContext and its own complete RGBA8 color FBO, with pixel readback/FBO identity oracles; original timestamps, nesting, elapsed-query coexistence and timeout oracles retained. Production code unchanged.
native_query_fixture_followup.independent_static_review: PASS; shader reviewer found no blocker
native_query_fixture_followup.native_rerun: PENDING at report creation; CI must confirm whether explicit FBO removes the observed GLX drawable failure.

conclusion: Pixel/contracts PASS on the initial PR tree. Mixed timing changes include repeatable negative tails and stable +32/+64 B heap costs. Neither overall performance improvement nor target-GPU/world FPS benefit is established. Causes remain unisolated; do not dismiss all tails as noise.
